rules.split_unit: individual frame; distinct frames from one video may cross splits
rules.content_deduplication: file SHA-256, decoded RGB SHA-256, and conservative verified re-encoding match
rules.source_binding: variants with the same normalized pre-Roboflow source ID remain in one split
rules.label_conflicts: exclude high-confidence identical-content groups whose labels disagree
rules.adjacent_frames: retained; different explicit video-frame IDs are never auto-merged by pHash
